newsitem.title: USA: Smith no longer qualifies for Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Smith no longer qualifies for Nasdaq.

text.p: Smith Technology Corp said Friday it no longer qualifies to be listed on the Nasdaq National Market, based on Nasdaq's net tangible asset and bid price requirements.
Smith said it has developed plans to correct the net tangible asset deficiency, which should allow it to apply for re-listing on the Nasdaq National Market in 1997.
"Provided we show improvement in our financial results during the coming year, I am confident that our stock price will increase accordingly," said Smith Chairman E. Brian Smith.
Smith, an engineering, remediation and construction firm, said at least three of its existing market makers will continue to trade Smith's stock through the OTC Bulletin Board System.
